record_title: Two-stage reproductive kernels force complete threshold convergence in a bistable age-structured population model
provenance: Exact two-stage phase-type reduction and Lyapunov analysis for the bistable Gurtin--MacCamy boundary-feedback model studied by Griette and Herrera (2026).
limitations: The theorem treats an explicit noncompact two-stage hypoexponential survival-weighted reproductive kernel, including Erlang-2 as a limit; it does not settle arbitrary noncompact fertility or higher-stage phase-type kernels. The most relevant 1979 finite-dimensional Gurtin--MacCamy paper was not independently inspected in full text.
